name: findcheap-agent
description: Search products from text or visual evidence, compare verified offers, find deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.17.7 shows current Coupon evidence directly on product cards and comparisons with explicit product-confirmed, merchant-wide, or unconfirmed applicability. Only a product-confirmed offer bound to the card's stable merchant product ID, with one unambiguous discount and no unresolved eligibility, may produce an estimated after-Coupon item price or affect equal-fit price ordering; merchant-wide Awin offers remain visible but never outrank a lower-priced product. The backend-selected primary recommendation is rendered first, while delivered-total comparisons keep quoted totals authoritative. v0.17.6 prevents a full product title from suppressing verified merchant-wide Awin offers, localizes no-offer and unavailable states, blocks empty comparison-ID calls, and rejects footwear terms such as slides, pumps, loafers, and mules before blouse or top image review. Comparison state stays inside the UI: cards provide sticky 2-4 selection, and the comparison view can quote delivered totals for those same immutable selection IDs with an in-view ZIP action. Visual search starts with brand and product family, performs one family-locked retry even when the first pass returns zero catalog candidates, preserves the top two structural details in that retry, and distinguishes zero retrieval candidates from secure image-load failure. Model-authored visual hard clues are downgraded at the execution boundary, and every candidate-image response stays nonterminal until its required visual finalization completes. Intended use stays outside product identity, requiredSize remains distinct from preferredSize, and real candidate-image payloads are bounded before they reach the shared safety executor. Every MCP tool routes through one shared safety executor, existing source ports remain behind a capability-based Backend facade, and the server generates the 2-4 column product comparison view. Comparison accepts only stable selections from one immutable live snapshot; the server determines same-product identity, facts, unknowns, limitations, common price basis, price delta, and the deterministic recommendation. Model-authored product facts and recommendation IDs are not accepted. Evidence-first search, three-tier card display, stable selected-product identity, and read-only safety boundaries remain unchanged. High-confidence suspected product names from interactive image analysis receive an exact official-store retrieval pass before descriptive visual fallback, without becoming identity proof. Broad laptops, phones, cameras, and displays request missing decision constraints before merchant search. Backend recommendation logic selects one stable primarySelectionId only when product fit and merchant evidence support a purchase recommendation; otherwise cards remain research-only. Official-site display order never forces the primary choice, and equally suitable trusted products prefer the lower comparable price. English and Chinese requests use the same structured decision with localized wording. Checkout remains the authority for eligibility, stacking, shipping, tax, and final totals. Commission never changes product relevance scoring. Unsupported sites may use user-authorized Chrome only as a bounded fallback. Product family and explicit brand/model stay hard; uncertain visual details remain soft clues and never create EXACT identity. The agent never invents identity, discount eligibility, stacking, merchant authorization, or delivered totals; it never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
